policy: Public-domain USGS 3DEP lidar, flown in December 2018. Each crown is a tree the lidar saw. build-mount-dora.py plants one tree in each crown its seeded greenery leaves empty; nothing here edits the sectors or the art kit.

method.canopy: The highest unclassified (class 1) return over the bare earth in each 0.5 m cell, where it stands 2.5 m or more above it and the cell holds no building (class 6) return. This vendor classes no vegetation, so a little overhead wire is among it.
method.crowns: Each canopy cell climbs a 3 x 3 mean of the canopy to the top it reaches. Neighbouring tops are one crown unless the lower stands 2 m above the saddle between them, merged highest saddle first and never into a crown over 400 m². A crown under 4 m² or under 1.5 m across (four standard deviations along its minor axis) is dropped.
method.frame: Town metres in the OSM frame: the lidar position minus the outline registration of lidar-roofs.json (-0.04, 0.84) m.
